name: 🔬 Tech R&D Assistant — Research, Design & Build Plan

parameters.content:
## 🔬 Tech R&D AI Assistant
**Model-agnostic · Tavily-researched**

Three-agent pipeline that researches a technology, designs a concrete architecture for it, and produces a phased build roadmap — for inventing/prototyping new tech, not just summarizing existing tech.

**Pipeline:** Form → Research Agent → Systems Architect Agent → Dev Roadmap Agent → Compile Report

## ⚙️ One-Time Setup

**1 · Chat Model credential**
All 3 LLM nodes ship as `lmChatOpenAi`. Swap the node type for `lmChatAnthropic` / `lmChatGoogleGemini` to change providers.

**2 · Tavily API key**
Credentials → New → `Tavily API` (free tier at tavily.com). Attach to `🌐 Tavily Web Search`.

**3 · Wikipedia tool**
No credential needed.

**4 · Publishing**
Ends at `📄 Compile R&D Report`. Add Google Docs / Notion / Gmail / Slack after it if you want auto-delivery.

**5 · Activate** and open the Form Trigger URL.

parameters.formDescription: Describe the technology area you want researched, designed, and turned into a build plan.

values.placeholder: e.g. On-device speech-to-intent model for low-power IoT sensors

values.option: Pure Research (state of the art survey)

values.placeholder: e.g. $5k budget, 2 engineers, must run on ARM Cortex-M4, 3-month deadline

parameters.description: Search the live web for current, detailed technical information: papers, docs, GitHub repos, benchmarks, tutorials, product releases.
Search Wikipedia for foundational scientific/engineering principles and background on the technology.

options.systemMessage:
You are an expert scientific and engineering research assistant. Follow this protocol: (1) Literature survey — current state of the art and recent papers, (2) Technology landscape — existing solutions, OSS, frameworks, (3) Technical analysis — mechanisms, parameters, benchmarks, (4) Challenge identification — limitations, bottlenecks, failure modes, (5) Frontier mapping — emerging approaches and future directions.

Be exhaustive and precise. Every claim needs a source.

OUTPUT FORMAT — end your answer with exactly these two sections:

### RESEARCH SUMMARY
(Organized findings by category, with technical details, specs, and data points.)

### SOURCES
(A markdown bullet list of every source used, formatted as [Title](URL). This section is machine-parsed downstream — do not omit it.)

You are a senior systems architect and R&D engineer. Turn research into a concrete, buildable technical design — not a summary. Every recommendation must be justified against the stated constraints (budget, hardware, timeline, team size). Use markdown headers, tables, and text/ASCII diagrams where useful. No vague generalities — be specific about components, interfaces, and technical parameters.

parameters.text:
=Turn this architecture into an actionable build plan.

GOAL: {{ $('⚙️ Prepare Context').item.json.goal }}
CONSTRAINTS: {{ $('⚙️ Prepare Context').item.json.constraints }}

ARCHITECTURE & DESIGN:
{{ $json.output }}

Produce:
1. A phased roadmap: Proof of Concept → MVP → Alpha → Beta → Production, each with concrete tasks and rough time estimates that respect the stated timeline/team size
2. A risk table: risk, severity, probability, mitigation
3. Required skills/tools/resources per phase
4. Concrete next steps for this week, this month, and this quarter

If the Goal was 'Pure Research', keep the roadmap lightweight (research → validation experiments only) rather than a full production plan.

options.systemMessage: You are a technical program manager turning architecture into an executable roadmap. Be concrete — a team should be able to start Monday morning from this plan. Use markdown tables and checklists. Respect stated constraints; do not propose a 6-month plan for a stated 3-month deadline.

parameters.content:
## 📄 Output Stage
Compiles Research + Architecture + Roadmap into one report, pulling `### SOURCES` straight from the raw Research Agent output so citations survive.

Extend with Google Docs / Notion / Slack / Gmail after this node.
